scope: Host-owned cooperative cancellation for synchronous native Session certification requests, retaining the original cumulative ledger and protected verifier authority.
graph_effect: Progress only. No status, priority, dependency, claim-tier or profile-gate promotion.
implementation: Session::certification_request_with_checkpoint accepts the owning host checkpoint policy and routes it through all certification helpers.
A borrowed RequestBudget shares one terminal checkpoint latch with ordinary and protected verifier work. It creates no ledger, lease, runtime, task or budget reset.
Registered sources, programs, accepted results and releases retain final response admission before publication. No post-publication callback can misreport a committed operation as cancelled.
Incremental search keeps previously completed candidate work and a valid frontier; later requests can resume on the same cumulative ledger.

adapter_tests.scope: Source-direct scratch harness includes the actual src/request_budget.rs and depends on the actual crates/fsym-budget. All eight dependency identity/source/checksum records match production Cargo.lock.
adapter_tests.reproduction: Create a scratch edition-2024 package with an empty [workspace], fsym-budget path dependency to this repository, and a lib.rs #[path] module referencing this repository src/request_budget.rs. Resolve the versions in adapter-lock-verification.json; use pinned nightly and run cargo test --lib.

formatting.scope: Changed Rust source and Session regression target using pinned rustfmt

independent_source_review.test_strengthening: Public regression additionally requires cancelled protected work to be nonzero and strictly less than a completed verification.

limits: This evidence does not validate the complete Session/CLI or production asynchronous runtime; executable integration checks are still pending at this checkpoint.
The callback is cooperative, synchronous and should be nonblocking. This adds no forced cancellation of arbitrary code and no asynchronous NDJSON cancellation endpoint.
Ordinary legacy Bind/Diff/Eval operations are outside this certification-specific API.
No complete campaign or compatibility profile is closed.
